# Estrada Concrete Company LLC

> Self-performing heavy civil contractor based in Hutchins, Texas, building street and
> alley reconstruction, concrete paving, and water, wastewater and storm-drainage utility
> systems for municipalities and owners across the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex.

## Company facts

- **Legal name:** Estrada Concrete Company, LLC
- **Founded:** 2007 (Texas LLC, formed 21 February 2007)
- **Employees:** approximately 125
- **Address:** 650 Skyline Drive, Hutchins, TX 75141, United States
- **Phone:** (972) 685-5477
- **Email:** bids@estradaconcrete.com
- **Website:** https://estrada-concrete.com/
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central
- **Service area:** Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex — Dallas, Fort Worth, Arlington, Irving,
  Plano, Garland, Frisco, McKinney, Denton, Mesquite, Grand Prairie, Carrollton, Terrell,
  Lancaster, Hutchins and surrounding North Texas cities.

## What Estrada does

Estrada self-performs its core scopes with its own crews and a 95-unit, $4.6M equipment
fleet, rather than subcontracting them out. Materials come from our affiliate Estrada Ready
Mix (https://www.estradareadymix.com/): ten ready-mix batch-plant locations across North and
Central Texas (Hutchins–Ennis area, Fort Worth area including Euless and Crowley, southern
DFW corridor from Waxahachie to Alvarado and Scurry, and Hillsboro), an asphalt plant near
Hutchins, mass-produced flex base, and aggregate supply — available to Estrada projects and
to outside contractors.

- Street and alley reconstruction (full-depth, including demolition and subgrade stabilization)
- Concrete paving — roadways, parking lots, overlays, approaches and drives
- Water mains, services, fire hydrants and valves
- Sanitary sewer mains and laterals, including deep cuts
- Storm drainage — RCP and RCB, inlets, junction structures, headwalls, channel work
- Cast-in-place structures — manholes, inlets, junction boxes, headwalls
- Site preparation, excavation, earthwork and grading
- Curb and gutter, sidewalks and ADA barrier-free ramps
- Traffic control, phasing and resident coordination on occupied blocks
- Materials supply: ready-mix concrete, asphalt, flex base and aggregates via Estrada Ready Mix

## Track record

More than $100 million of municipal reconstruction and utility work delivered for the
City of Dallas, Dallas Water Utilities, the City of Mesquite, the City of Terrell, the
City of Garland and the City of Hutchins, including individual contracts exceeding
$22 million. Owner references and payment contacts are furnished on request.

## Markets served

Municipal, commercial, residential and industrial.

## Working with Estrada

- **Owners and general contractors:** send drawings and bid documents to
  bids@estradaconcrete.com for a line-item bid, typically returned within one business day.
- **Prequalification:** qualification packages, certificates of insurance, coverage limits,
  EMR and bonding capacity are provided on request, usually the same day.
- **Subcontractors and vendors:** introductions welcome at bids@estradaconcrete.com.
  Scopes bought out include trucking, striping, traffic control, SWPPP, landscaping,
  electrical and fencing. Materials purchased include ready-mix, aggregates, pipe,
  precast, rebar, lumber and equipment rental.
- **Job seekers:** hiring pipelayers, equipment operators, concrete finishers, form
  setters, CDL drivers, foremen and general laborers. Apply at bids@estradaconcrete.com.
